$description: Per-platform implementation status for every component Crystal specifies. Generated from core/tokens/catalogue/ with status merged from libraries/status/<platform>.json. A component present in one library is expected in the others, with the same states, semantics, surfaces and token bindings.

components.name: Terminal
components.why: A shell emulator is an application, not a design-system component.

components.name: Border beam
components.why: Crystal specifies edge treatment as the Resin optical rim. A second, unrelated mechanism for a moving border would contradict the material spec, and the ambient tier that would have owned it is deferred.
